summary: All four files contain genuine formal mathematical content: definitions, theorems, lemmas, and tactic proofs. BinaryFields.lean formalizes GF(2) and GF(2ⁿ) with boolean gate polynomials, Frobenius, trace, and adder circuits. Characteristic.lean develops the characteristic-p theory including freshman's dream and the squaring dichotomy. Multilinear.lean builds multivariate Schwartz-Zippel, multilinear extensions over 𝔽₂, Möbius inversion, and MLE uniqueness. Pairings.lean defines the bilinear pairing interface, derives exponent laws, and formalizes DDH checks, Joux key agreement, and BLS signatures with aggregation. No file is a pure import aggregator, build script, or documentation-only; each contributes unique formal mathematics.
